_comment: Curated links and documents, grouped by category. Edit this file to add, remove or reorder entries — no code, no database, no admin login. Every URL here was checked and returned HTTP 200 on 2026-07-29. Add PDFs by dropping them in files/ and pointing url at files/your-doc.pdf.
